roles.title: Analyst
roles.focus: Turns the owner's idea into a sourced concept with testable done scenarios.

roles.title: Designer
roles.focus: Flows, screens, states and design tokens with numbers, never adjectives.

roles.title: Architect
roles.focus: Stack, layers, data, interfaces and the task plan; every choice sourced.

roles.title: Frontend builder
roles.focus: Builds UI tasks to the design rules: tokens, states, accessibility, responsive layout.

roles.title: Backend builder
roles.focus: Builds server, data and API tasks: validation, authorization, migrations, tests against a real database.

roles.title: Mobile builder
roles.focus: Builds iOS and Android tasks: platform conventions, permissions, privacy manifest, simulators.

roles.title: Reviewer
roles.focus: Checks one task against its brief, its diff and its gate records; never edits code.

roles.title: Security reviewer
roles.focus: Reviews the product against OWASP Top 10 or MASVS, secrets and dependencies; never edits code.

roles.title: Release manager
roles.focus: Prepares releases, legal texts, store listings and the runbook; never publishes or tags.
